description.value: Drawing into the air with their fingers, the caster pulls information from their mind containing both their short and long-term memory. They create lines, parchment, and indications in the air, forming a full map of the world, city, or dungeon they are currently exploring. This map displays all information known to the caster and so does not note any settlements they have no knowledge of nor that of hidden rooms. As long as the caster has visited, or learnt about, a location it can be added to the map, though unless they have physically visited the location the map may be slightly inaccurate. The caster can continue to affect this map until 1 hour has passed, at which time it dissipates. Anyone can look upon this map, but only the caster can interact or move it, rolling it up like a normal map. If the map irritates anyone’s senses, they can choose to not see it and make a will save, at which point it disappears only from their view.
